segments.name: AI service software
segments.description: Provides AI-powered employee experience and customer experience service software to organizations of all sizes worldwide, sold as subscriptions.
segments.evidence: We operate in a single operating segment composed of the consolidated financial results of Freshworks.

revenueModel.text: Businesses of all sizes pay subscription fees for employee experience and customer experience software, after trying products under free trial plans.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer our products under both free trial and paid subscription plans, further reducing friction to adoption and accelerating our go-to-market motion.
